description:
Bowe Property are delighted to present to the market No. 6 Ring Finnan Avenue, a superb three-bedroom semi-detached residence situated within the highly desirable Kinsale Manor development, just a short stroll from the heart of Kinsale town. This impressive A-rated property comes to the market for the first time, offering an exceptional opportunity for first-time buyers, those looking to downsize, investors or purchasers seeking an ideal holiday home. Designed with modern living and energy efficiency in mind, the accommodation extends to three generously proportioned bedrooms, master en-suite, a well-appointed family bathroom, ground floor guest w.c., an inviting front lounge, while the bright open-plan kitchen/dining/living area provides the perfect space for everyday family life and entertaining, complemented by a generous utility room. Externally, the property enjoys beautifully presented, south-facing sun-drenched rear patio gardens with attractive raised flower beds, creating a private and welcoming outdoor space ideal for al fresco dining, relaxation and entertaining. Finished to an excellent standard throughout, the property boasts gas-fired central heating, a high-gloss fitted kitchen complete with premium integrated appliances, quality ceramic tiling, built-in wardrobes, photovoltaic solar panels and a host of additional features that enhance both comfort and efficiency. Occupying an enviable position within one of Kinsale's most sought-after residential developments, No. 6 Ring Finnan Avenue offers the perfect balance of style, convenience and modern living, all within easy walking distance of the town's renowned amenities, waterfront, cafés and restaurants.
